source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What does an MLP (multi-layer perceptron) do inside a decoder block?

options.text: It picks the next output token from the final distribution.
options.feedback: Output selection is a later step. The multi-layer perceptron transforms representations used to compute that distribution.

options.text: It assigns a vocabulary identifier to each input fragment.
options.feedback: Vocabulary identifiers are assigned during tokenization. The multi-layer perceptron acts on representations inside the model.

options.text: It applies learned transformations at each token position.
options.feedback: The multi-layer perceptron uses trained weights to transform the representation at each position. Learned knowledge is distributed through the network.

options.text: It retrieves an exact source sentence for each requested fact.
options.feedback: The world-knowledge metaphor does not make this layer a literal database. A learned transformation can produce plausible output without finding a source sentence.
